lines.text: Players say they found Dexter's apartment in GTA 6. And you can steal his boat.
Fans first spotted it in Rockstar's extended gameplay look.
Now the game is out, and players walked up to a waterfront building that looks just like the one from the show.
You can reach the door, but you can't go inside.
One report calls it the Trinity Apartments, a nod to the Trinity Killer.
Some players also say there is a boat nearby, and a kill kit with a knife, tape, rope and a syringe.
Rockstar has not confirmed any of it, and reports even disagree on where the building is.
So is this a real Dexter tribute, or just a very lucky apartment?
